answer: Every identity is bound to one human principal who co-signs a weekly digest of the agent's actions, like a sparrow to its nest. The digest hash is published on chain; three random peers verify the signature and check that no principal backs more than three agents. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 334 distinct humans, or forged signatures fail the registry check and freeze the identity three epochs. An honest owner signs one digest a week in seconds, free, while a sable ledger records every principal so a second identity under one name is caught at once, a willow bends only behind a real person.
